about: Held-out AI polish cases (bench/suite.py polish run --cases-file polish_cases_holdout.json): written after the prompt experiments on polish_cases.json, so a prompt tuned on those can be checked on dictations it wasn't shaped by. Same format and rules. Corrections use an explicit marker (哦不对): "A不是B" reads as a contrast (A, not B), not a correction, so cases written that way were ambiguous and were reworded.

cases.raw: book the conference room on the third floor actually make it the fifth floor for 10 people
cases.expected: Book the conference room on the fifth floor for 10 people.

cases.raw: we raised the price to 20 dollars uh no 25 dollars per seat last month
cases.expected: We raised the price to 25 dollars per seat last month.

cases.raw: summarize this thread for me and list the action items
cases.expected: Summarize this thread for me and list the action items.

cases.raw: write a SQL query that counts users by country
cases.expected: Write a SQL query that counts users by country.

cases.raw: so basically um what happened was the the cache got invalidated and like every request hit the database at the same time you know so it fell over
cases.expected: What happened was the cache got invalidated and every request hit the database at the same time, so it fell over.
